title: Starting a business
summary: This page provides comprehensive support and resources for planning, setting up, and growing a business in New South Wales.
intro:
Planning to start a business in NSW? From testing your idea, developing a business plan and accessing finance, through to meeting government requirements and creating a marketing strategy, we can support you every step of the way.

Explore our resources or book a call with our team.

Book a call

faqs.q: How can I get support when starting a business in NSW?
faqs.a: Service NSW can support you through every step, from testing your idea and developing a business plan to meeting government requirements and creating a marketing strategy.

faqs.q: Where can I find resources to help me start a business?
faqs.a: You can access free videos, podcasts, and articles through the online resources provided.

faqs.q: What steps should I take before I officially start my business?
faqs.a: You can learn about key steps in planning and preparing to set up a business using the guide.
